habit.lifeForm.basis: RHS plant record: "a large deciduous climber with twining stems". Bean: "A strong-growing, deciduous climber".

stem.twiningHandedness.basis: As in taxon.json. RHS: "anticlockwise", no viewpoint stated; viewed from above per Valder (1995); Darwin: "moves against the sun"; Flora of China: "stems twined leftward". All describe a right-handed helix (vocab.ts HANDEDNESS).

leaf.division.basis: RHS plant record: "dark green, pinnate leaves". Bean: "Leaves pinnate".

leaf.colour.basis: RHS plant record: "dark green, pinnate leaves". Bean: "deep rich green and glabrous above, somewhat hairy beneath".

leaf.autumnColour.basis: The species profile records yellowing leaves in autumn, from the season grid of the RHS record. The grid was not read again for this file.

leaf.lengthM.basis: Bean (Trees and Shrubs Online): "Leaves pinnate, 10 to 12 in. long". The whole compound leaf, in metres.

leaf.leafletCount.basis: Bean: "consisting usually of eleven leaflets". The usual number, not a range: Bean gives none.

leaf.leafletLengthM.basis: Bean: leaflets "1 1/2 to 4 in. long", in metres.

leaf.leafletWidthM.basis: Bean: leaflets "1/2 to 1 1/2 in. wide", in metres.

inflorescence.type.basis: RHS plant record: "drooping racemes to 30cm in length".

inflorescence.held.basis: RHS plant record: "drooping racemes"; of the genus, "long pendulous racemes". The growth model's names section records the same thing as flowerHeld: hanging.

inflorescence.lengthM.basis: Bean: "Racemes 8 to 12 in. long", in metres. The RHS record agrees on the upper end: "racemes to 30cm in length".

flower.colour.basis: RHS plant record: "fragrant, mauve or lilac-coloured flowers". Bean: "Flowers mauve or lilac-coloured".

flower.shape.basis: Bean: "each flower about 1 in. long, pea-flower shaped".

flower.lengthM.basis: Bean: "each flower about 1 in. long", in metres.

flower.stalkLengthM.basis: Bean: flowers "borne singly on stalks 1/2 to 3/4 in. long", in metres.

flower.scent.basis: RHS plant record: "fragrant, mauve or lilac-coloured flowers".

flower.opensRelativeToLeaves.basis: RHS plant record: flowers "opening before the leaves".

fruit.type.basis: Bean: "Pod rather like that of a kidney bean".

fruit.lengthM.basis: Bean: pod "5 or 6 in. long", in metres. The growth model's fruit.lengthM is the same figure.

fruit.widthM.basis: Bean: pod "3/4 in. wide towards the end", in metres. The widest part: the pod narrows towards its stalk.

fruit.shape.basis: Bean: pod "club-shaped, 3/4 in. wide towards the end".

fruit.surface.basis: Bean: pod "covered with a velvety pile".

fruit.seedCount.basis: Bean: pod "containing two or three seeds".
